::: {.callout-warning}
**Not available yet.** The export is deployed, but the Partner Portal is not
in production yet. The table will appear in Athena once production traffic
arrives. Until then, queries against it fail with a "table not found" error.
:::

Daily traffic for the CanadaLogin Partner Portal GA4 property, broken down by
page.

Each row represents one day of traffic to a single Partner Portal page,
identified by its title, its path, and the data stream that reported it.

`Keywords`: Google Analytics, GA4, Partner Portal, page views, traffic, page title, page path, data stream

## Provenance

Pulled daily from the GA4 Data API (`runReport`) for the Partner Portal
property, via the same Lambda and pipeline as
[`page_traffic`](page_traffic.qmd). Only the production data stream is
exported. The property's dev, test, and staging stream is left out.

* **Updated**: Daily, at 07:00 ET
* **Retention**: 7 years
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca) (Data and Research team)
* **Location**: `s3://<transformed-bucket>/google_analytics/partner_portal_page_traffic/`

## Fields

One row per `date` per `streamname` per `pagetitle` per `pagepath`.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| date | string | The reporting day, as a partition key (for example, "2026-07-23") |
| streamid | string | Numeric ID of the GA4 data stream that reported the page |
| streamname | string | Display name of the GA4 data stream |
| pagetitle | string | The page's `<title>` at the time of the visit |
| pagepath | string | The page's URL path |
| sessions | integer | Number of sessions that included this page on this day |
| activeusers | integer | Number of distinct active users who viewed this page on this day |
| screenpageviews | integer | Number of times this page was viewed on this day |

## Notes

**This is a separate GA4 property from CanadaLogin.** Its users and sessions
are counted independently of [`page_traffic`](page_traffic.qmd) and
[`property_traffic`](property_traffic.qmd). Do not union or sum it with those
tables to get a CanadaLogin total.

**The production stream is selected by ID.** The export filters on `streamid`,
so a renamed stream still lands here. Filter on `streamid`, not `streamname`,
if you need to pin the stream in a query.

**Only `screenpageviews` sums across pages.** GA4 counts `activeusers` and
`sessions` *within* a row's dimension combination, so a user or session that
touched three pages in a day appears in all three rows. Summing either across
pages overcounts.

**Keep both `pagetitle` and `pagepath` in mind when filtering.** A retitled
page starts a fresh row with no link to its history. Prefer `pagepath` for
anything that needs to survive a copy or title change.
